text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's raced Smart Falcon, the
undisputed
champion of dirt races, in
three G1s now.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! This magazine has an article
about how
I've won three consecutive
G1s against Falco...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I guess we've accomplished some
amazing things,
huh? It's all thanks to
you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We won the JBC Classic, the Tokyo
Daishoten,
and the Kawasaki Kinen.
choice_data_list: No, this is a great feat for both ...
No, it's an achievement for both o...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
People might have dismissed one win as
a fluke,
but you can't argue with these
results.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm happy I won and everything, but... I
never
expected an article like this.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Look, they call me Falco's "archnemesis."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I don't like the sound of that at all. I don't want to be anyone's archnemesis or any kind of nemesis.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Heyo! ☆ Don't even worry about that
silly article,
Acute!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Ah. Hello, Falco.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I think of you as an Umadol
hater or
anything!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Actually... It's the total opposite.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Do you know what I mean? Here, guess
who you
remind me of more than
anyone.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Huh, me? Uhhh... I don't know...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Maybe the tortoise that chases the hare?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Um, not quite... Here, I'll just tell you!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You're like the most loyal, dedicated fan
ever!
One who comes to every show! ♪
Aaaaand...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I've got a present for my biggest fan! ♪

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: O-oh, wow...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Get it? Because it's a fan! ☆ I even
signed it for
you, with lots of love.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for always staying focused on
me and
chasing after me with everything
you've got. ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That's why, talented as I might be,
you're the only
one who keeps catching
me.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, oh my... How can I accept
something
this precious?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Is it really okay? Thank you...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer dearie. Come look at what Falco
gave me.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: It's a fan! And it feels great! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Haha! You're such a cutie, Acute!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute can't stop smiling after
receiving
her gift.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You know, Trainer. Falco said such nice
things to
me, but...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I think it's actually because of her that
I've been
able to race as well as I have.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, she's so good that just setting my
sights on
her is enough to get stronger.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Falco doesn't have like anyone like that
to guide her, yet she still rushes ahead
without fear,
continuing to forge the
path for the rest of us.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I think that kind of grit is what it
really
means to
be strong.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's got a point. Having a clear goal
ahead of us
does make the races
remarkably easier.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having Smart Falcon leading the way is a
big part
of why we were able to do so
well these past
three races.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
When I think about all Falco's done, I
realize how
far I still have to go...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
In fact, I don't think I've managed to
catch up to her at all. When I look at her
back, it's still... such
a long way in the
distance.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: But even still... she gave me this fan...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I can't stop smiling. When I look at this
fan...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
It's Smart Falcon and Wonder Acute!
Smart
Falcon and Wonder Acute are
neck and neck!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Can Wonder Acute seize victory? Or will
Smart
Falcon stand firm?

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
You can't tear your eyes away from this
dead
heat!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'll remember all the races we've run
together. I'll
never forget any of them,
and I don't think
anyone else will either.
